title: DR100 Resource Record
description: Schema for a single drug-resource record in the DR100 registry. Designed to be consumed by LLM-driven drug agents.

aliases.description: Alternative names, abbreviations, or version-specific identifiers.

type.description: Resource type: knowledge graph (KG), database (DB), or dataset.

subcategory.description: Content subcategory within the primary category (32 distinct labels in the current table).

paradigm.description: Knowledge consumption mode in the Review. LLM-Friendly: information can mainly be interpreted after retrieval. Tool-Mediated: specialized computation is needed first.

pathway.description: Main knowledge interface in the Review (historical field name). Direct Prompt = Direct Prompting, RAG = Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Graph Query = Graph Queries, REST = Structured REST APIs, Computational = Computational Tool Invocation, Hybrid = Hybrid Interfaces. Null when unassigned.

identifier.description: Main identifier system recorded for the resource ('name only' when no structured identifier was recorded). Null when unassigned.

access.description: Main access approach recorded for the resource. Null when unassigned.

license.description: License class (when known). Free-text since licenses vary widely.

update_cadence.description: Resource update status. Periodic Recent, Moderate, and Stale correspond to about one year, one to two years, and two to five years since the last update; Static marks a deliberately fixed release. Null when unassigned.

task_tags.description: Task tags, recorded for Drug-centric resources only. T1 identification, T2 labeling, T3 mechanism, T4 safety, T5 drug-drug interaction, T6 target binding, T7 response, T8 repurposing, T9 combination.

task_tags_verified.description: True for broad knowledge bases whose task tags were checked individually.

aim.description: Short statement of the resource's primary purpose.

description.description: Full descriptive paragraph for the resource.

link.description: Primary URL for accessing the resource.

paper_link.description: DOI or URL to the canonical citation paper.

data_quality.description: Status label from the construction script. authoritative: exact name match with accepted annotations. needs_review: approximate or missing name match, or default-looking annotations. Describes the construction process, not an independent validation.
